title: Flappy Dumbledore: DUMBLEDORE! DUMBLEDORE! DUMBLEDORE!
story: The whole Great Hall is banging the tables chanting your name like it's a football match. You are John Lithgow's Dumbledore. Squeeze through the wall of Gryffindor and Slytherin banners before somebody asks if you're a bit mad.
inspiration: HBO's first Harry Potter series clip (aired 2026-11-14, memes through 11-16..18) shows students slamming tables and chanting 'Dumbledore!' as John Lithgow's headmaster arrives; fans called it cringe / 'Temu Harry Potter'. Bird = Lithgow Dumbledore cutout from the HBO still, sky = the clip's chanting-Harry frame as a pulsing 4-frame GIF, pillars = alternating Gryffindor/Slytherin house banners (pillar2). Archetype: Gauntlet — banners packed shoulder to shoulder like the chanting crowd. Rolling window: adds the GIF + pillar2 days the last 6 dailies lacked.
